jobs.title: Business Analyst, Finance & Billing
jobs.description:
The Business Analyst, Finance \& Billing serves as a critical bridge between Finance and Technology, translating business strategy into system\-enabled solutions that improve financial operations, billing accuracy, and reporting. This role partners closely with Finance, IT, and cross\-functional leaders to define requirements, optimize processes, and ensure technology platforms effectively support Brightspeed’s financial and customer lifecycle operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with Finance leaders to understand business objectives and translate them into clear, measurable business and functional requirements.
* Lead the end\-to\-end requirements lifecycle, including stakeholder interviews, workshops, documentation, and validation across Finance, Billing, and Revenue functions.
* Develop and maintain business requirements documents, process flows, and functional specifications to support IT design and development.
* Ensure alignment between Finance business needs and enterprise platforms, including SAP S/4HANA, BRIM, ARIBA, RAR, billing systems, and analytics platforms.
* Identify process gaps and recommend automation, system enhancements, and workflow improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and control.
* Partner with Product Owners and Platform teams to translate requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs in Jira or similar tools.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, testing cycles, and release readiness to ensure solutions are delivered on time and meet business expectations.
* Support development and testing teams by clarifying requirements, validating solutions, and assisting with defect triage and resolution.
* Serve as the primary Finance liaison for technology initiatives, ensuring transparency, alignment, and timely decision\-making.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to Finance and IT stakeholders through governance forums and project updates.
* Develop test scenarios and lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate solutions before deployment.
* Validate post\-deployment results, ensuring adoption, performance, and business outcomes meet expectations.


**Company Description**
 At Brightspeed, we are reimagining how people live, work, play and connect by providing fast, reliable internet connections and an awesome customer experience in twenty states throughout the Midwest and South.
   

  

 Backed by funds managed by Apollo Global Management,
 **our vision is to accelerate the upgrade of copper to fiber optic technologies, bringing faster and more reliable internet service to many rural markets traditionally underserved by broadband providers, while delivering best\-in\-class customer experience.**
 Be a part of the team that will make this vision a reality….designing and building a world class fiber network and creating a customer experience second to none.
   

  

 Check us out on the web!
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* 5–10 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role in a technology\-enabled business environment.
* 5–10 years of experience supporting financial systems, billing platforms, or enterprise technology implementations.
* Experience leading business requirements, functional specifications, testing cycles, and release readiness across multiple systems.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into system\-based solutions.
* Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work across Finance, IT, and business leadership.
* Proficiency with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Zephyr, QTest, Smartsheet, or similar project and testing platforms.
* Strong documentation, organization, and process design capabilities.
* Ability to drive continuous improvement and challenge existing processes constructively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, BRIM, RAR, ARIBA, billing platforms, and revenue or cash applications.
* Experience with data analytics, reporting, and customer lifecycle systems (e.g., Looker, Power BI, SQL).
* Experience in telecommunications, subscription\-based, or high\-volume billing environments.
* PMP, ScrumMaster, or similar project management or Agile certification.


**Physical Demands \& Work Conditions**
* Primarily office\-based or remote work environment with prolonged use of a computer and standard office equipment.
* Ability to attend meetings (virtual and in\-person) and work across multiple time zones as needed.
* Occasional travel may be required based on project needs.


 Additional Information
   

  

**WHY JOIN US?**
**We aspire to contemporary ways of working.**
 Recognized as a Top Workplace by the Charlotte Observer, Brightspeed HQ is located on the 7th floor of the new Vantage South End \- East Tower in Charlotte, NC. We prioritize hiring talent in the Charlotte area, whenever possible, to make it a truly vibrant destination for our hybrid workforce. At Brightspeed, we have roles that are designated as remote, hybrid, office or field\-based, depending on the position, business needs and individual circumstances. We also invest in technology that enables our entire team to stay connected. Why? Because Brightspeed recognizes the value of finding the best talent for the job, wherever they may be.
   

  

**We Offer Competitive Compensation And Comprehensive Benefits.**
 Our benefits and paid time off programs reflect our underlying belief in promoting overall wellness through physical, emotional and financial health. Brightspeed

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Project Manager / Support Lead to manage our production support, continuous enhancement, and operational governance across the SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) landscape. This role combines hands\-on functional understanding of core BRIM pillars with project management discipline. You will lead a blended onshore/offshore team, enforce ITIL\-based SLA/KPI targets, drive critical incident resolution, and govern small\-to\-medium business enhancements from scoping to hypercare.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 1\. Support Operations \& SLA Governance Lead day\-to\-day operations for Level 2 and Level 3 production support across the entire SAP BRIM suite. Own and report operational KPIs: mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), SLA compliance (\>98%), ticket backlog trends, and first\-time\-fix rates. Serve as the primary escalation point for Priority 1/2 billing, mediation, rating, and invoicing incidents; lead root cause analyses (RCA) and post\-mortem discussions. Manage high\-volume recurring operations: month\-end billing cycles, automated rating batches, bill\-run failures, out\-of\-sequence consumption data, and financial posting reconciliations. 2\. Project Management \& Continuous Improvement Manage minor release cadences, change requests (CRs), and platform enhancements using hybrid Agile/Scrum or Waterfall frameworks. Own project schedules, resource allocations, sprint backlogs, risk/issues/assumptions/dependencies (RAID) logs, and release readiness checklists. Coordinate end\-to\-end delivery: requirement discovery, solution design review, build, system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, cutover, and post\-deployment stabilization. Interface directly with business finance, IT steering committees, external System Integrators (SIs), and vendor partners.
 



 3\. Functional Oversight \& Solution Integrity Provide functional governance across core modules: SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management): Subscription lifecycle, master agreements, product catalog, provider contracts. SAP CC (Convergent Charging): Rating and charging logic, charge plans, allowance logic, subscriber mapping. SAP CI (Convergent Invoicing): Billable items (BITs), consumption items (CITs), bill runs, aggregation, invoicing rules. SAP RAR: Revenue postings, reconciliation \& rev\-rec. Coordinate integration integrity with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP CPQ, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), external CRM, and data mediation layers. Required
 



**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Total Experience: 8\+ years of IT delivery/support experience, with at least 4\+ years dedicated to SAP BRIM (formerly Hybris Billing) and 3\+ years running project management or application maintenance services (AMS). Core Technical Expertise: Functional or technical depth in at least two of the four BRIM components (SOM, CC, CI, RAR) alongside familiarity with the overall end\-to\-end data pipeline. Support Frameworks: Proven experience running structured ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management) using tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or SAP Solution Manager. Project Delivery: Demonstrated success managing cross\-functional technical teams (developers, functional consultants, BASIS, middleware teams) across distributed time zones. Integration Acumen: Familiarity with modern SAP interface technologies (OData, REST APIs, IDocs, SAP CPI) and reconciliation between rated events and general ledger entries.

jobs.title: Billing And Revenue Support Team Leader
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US\-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.
  

  

AES has been **ranked \#1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.**
  

  

We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.


Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven\-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty\-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry.  

  

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

  

Under general or limited supervision position the Team Leader, Billing and Revenue Support is responsible and accountable for:

 **Job Description Summary**


AES is seeking a FICA Team Leader, within the Billing and Revenue Support department. In this role, the incumbent will provide day\-to\-day operational leadership, coaching, and subject\-matter expertise for payment processing, credit management, and fraud prevention within Billing and Revenue Support for an electric utility company in a union setting. This role coordinates workload and staffing, monitors productivity, quality, and leads to resolution of complex or escalated customer and account payment and fraud issues. The Team Leader partners with internal teams and third\-party vendors to ensure accurate and timely payment posting, strengthen credit and fraud controls, meet audit and risk\-management requirements, and advance continuous improvement while protecting company revenue and supporting customer operations.

* **Job Description**


Under general or limited supervision, the FICA Team Leader, Billing and Revenue Support is responsible and accountable for:

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the FICA team’s daily operations, including workload allocation, staffing support, scheduling, and performance monitoring.
* Coach, train, and guide team members on FICA policies, procedures, systems, and service expectations.
* Monitor productivity, quality, and service\-level results; address performance gaps and recognize opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness.
* Resolve complex and escalated customer or account issues in partnership with internal departments and external service providers.
* Ensure FICA activities comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, internal controls, audit standards, and risk\-management practices.
* Conduct quality reviews, identify root causes, and lead the implementation of process and procedure improvements.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports, performance metrics, dashboards, and management updates.
* Monitor payment\-posting projects and open items with third\-party vendors, including KUBRA, Firstech, and RPS.
* Perform daily cash, payment, and batch\-file inspections to confirm accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Monitor weather conditions and update SAP as required to support account disconnection activities.
* Prepare and submit quarterly tax\-exempt reports to applicable state agencies.
* Conduct weekly reviews of SAP IS\-U batch and payment lots to verify that payments are posted accurately to customer accounts.
* Verify that transmittals are processed and posted accurately and on schedule.
* Oversee credit\-management activities, including customer credit risk, deposits, payment arrangements, account restrictions, write\-off considerations, and policy exceptions.
* Monitor payment and account activity for potential fraud, suspicious transactions, identity concerns, or misuse; ensure appropriate documentation, account safeguards, and timely escalation.
* Analyze credit and fraud trends, support investigations and recovery efforts, maintain effective controls, and recommend improvements that reduce financial loss and protect customer information.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer\-focused service.

 **Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Associate degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least two years of leadership or supervisory experience are required.
* Working knowledge of billing, payment processing, collections, credit management, and applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications; experience with SAP ISU or comparable customer information and payment\-processing systems is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex issues, make sound business decisions, and manage competing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal, coaching, and training skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and work independently with limited supervision.
* Experience in an inbound contact center and with related technologies is preferred.
* Experience in a regulated utility or another regulated work environment is preferred.
* Supervisory experience in a union environment is preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to adapt quickly to changing business needs.

jobs.title: SAP Subscription Billing & Revenue Accounting (RAR) Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**
 Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career.
   

  

 At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose\-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day.
   

  

 Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end subscription\-to\-revenue solution architecture: run Fit\-to\-Standard / explore\-phase workshops, drive Key Design Decisions, and produce solution and RICEFW documentation aligned to SAP Activate methodology.
* Configure RAR on S/4HANA — revenue accounting contracts, performance obligations (POBs), BRFplus decision tables, account determination, and posting logic for point\-in\-time and over\-time recognition — as part of the ECC\-to\-S/4HANA conversion.
* Architect the SAP Subscription Billing solution (cloud, on SAP BTP): rate plans and pricing, subscription lifecycle, usage rating/metering, and bill creation for recurring, one\-time, usage/consumption\-based, and tiered models.
* Design the integration between SAP Subscription Billing and S/4HANA \- billing/invoice data flowing into Convergent Invoicing (FI\-CA) and/or SD billing, and onward into RAR — using SAP Integration Suite / API\-based (iFlow) patterns; define the BTP integration and data architecture.
* Lead fit\-gap analysis on complex subscription and revenue scenarios — multi\-element/bundled software\-plus\-service deals, ramp deals, mid\-term upgrades/downgrades and proration, cancellations and credits, usage overages, and contract modifications under ASC 606\.
* Design the inflight\-contract transition and initial\-load strategy; define the migration approach for revenue data moving off ECC, and the onboarding/migration approach for active subscriptions into SAP Subscription Billing.
* Ensure RAR sub\-ledger reconciliation with FI\-GL and COPA, and reconciliation between Subscription Billing, invoicing (CI/FI\-CA), and revenue; validate G/L postings with accounting teams and support disclosure and reporting needs.
* Direct integration, regression, and UAT testing across the S/4HANA and BTP landscape; lead cutover, go\-live, and hypercare, including high\-volume order, subscription, and usage\-data conversion validation.
* Own the solution post\-go\-live: lead support, period\-close and billing\-cycle support, enhancements, and SAP release/upgrade impact assessments (including the cloud release cadence of Subscription Billing), and maintain solution documentation and governance.
* Manage and direct system integrator (SI) resources, coordinate with internal functional/configuration teams, and partner with internal audit, external auditors, and controllership on ongoing compliance and revenue policy changes.


**Qualifications**
* Hands\-on SAP RAR configuration experience across full\-lifecycle implementations and/or ECC\-to\-S/4HANA conversions; relevant SAP certifications (RAR, SD/FI) preferred.
* Experience implementing or integrating SAP Subscription Billing (the standalone cloud product on BTP), including rate plans, usage rating, and the S/4HANA integration pattern; familiarity with Convergent Invoicing (FI\-CA) as the landing point is an asset.
* Deep IFRS 15 / ASC 606 revenue recognition expertise as applied to subscription and multi\-element arrangements, including transition and initial\-load strategies.
* Strong command of BRFplus, ARL, and RAI\-based integration between billing and RAR.
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration / iFlows, APIs) for cloud\-to\-S/4HANA integration.
* Proven OTC/QTC and order/subscription\-management architecture experience (pricing, account determination, Fiori) feeding billing and revenue.
* Preferred experience with SAP ECC to S/4 HANA migration or full life cycle S/4 HANA Implementation and support.
* Fluency in SAP Activate deliverables by phase and in cutover discipline (freeze windows, mock cycles, reconciliation gates, go/no\-go).
* RAR / event\-based revenue recognition exposure for subscriptions.
* Familiarity with S/4HANA Private Cloud (RISE) deployment and SAP Activate; FI\-GL and COPA integration knowledge.
* Demonstrated ability to lead internal teams and SI partners, and to bridge technical and accounting/business audiences.


**Education and experience required:**
 This position is available at three different career levels based upon experience:
   

  

* Level I: 2 years IT or related business process experience
* Level II: 3 years IT or related business process experience and 2 years SAP configuration experience in the SD modules
* Level III: 5 years IT or related Sales and Distribution business process experience and 5 years SAP configuration experience in SD modules


**Preferred:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Science, Computer Science, or related discipline.

**Company Description**  

At Brightspeed, we are reimagining how people live, work, play and connect by providing fast, reliable internet connections and an awesome customer experience in twenty states throughout the Midwest and South.


Backed by funds managed by Apollo Global Management, **our vision is to accelerate the upgrade of copper to fiber optic technologies, bringing faster and more reliable internet service to many rural markets traditionally underserved by broadband providers, while delivering best\-in\-class customer experience.**


Be a part of the team that will make this vision a reality….designing and building a world class fiber network and creating a customer experience second to none.


Check us out on the web!

 **Job Description**  

The Business Analyst, Finance \& Billing serves as a critical bridge between Finance and Technology, translating business strategy into system\-enabled solutions that improve financial operations, billing accuracy, and reporting. This role partners closely with Finance, IT, and cross\-functional leaders to define requirements, optimize processes, and ensure technology platforms effectively support Brightspeed’s financial and customer lifecycle operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Finance leaders to understand business objectives and translate them into clear, measurable business and functional requirements.
* Lead the end\-to\-end requirements lifecycle, including stakeholder interviews, workshops, documentation, and validation across Finance, Billing, and Revenue functions.
* Develop and maintain business requirements documents, process flows, and functional specifications to support IT design and development.
* Ensure alignment between Finance business needs and enterprise platforms, including SAP S/4HANA, BRIM, ARIBA, RAR, billing systems, and analytics platforms.
* Identify process gaps and recommend automation, system enhancements, and workflow improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and control.
* Partner with Product Owners and Platform teams to translate requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs in Jira or similar tools.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, testing cycles, and release readiness to ensure solutions are delivered on time and meet business expectations.
* Support development and testing teams by clarifying requirements, validating solutions, and assisting with defect triage and resolution.
* Serve as the primary Finance liaison for technology initiatives, ensuring transparency, alignment, and timely decision\-making.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to Finance and IT stakeholders through governance forums and project updates.
* Develop test scenarios and lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate solutions before deployment.
* Validate post\-deployment results, ensuring adoption, performance, and business outcomes meet expectations.

 **Qualifications** **Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* 5–10 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role in a technology\-enabled business environment.
* 5–10 years of experience supporting financial systems, billing platforms, or enterprise technology implementations.
* Experience leading business requirements, functional specifications, testing cycles, and release readiness across multiple systems.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

 **Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into system\-based solutions.
* Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work across Finance, IT, and business leadership.
* Proficiency with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Zephyr, QTest, Smartsheet, or similar project and testing platforms.
* Strong documentation, organization, and process design capabilities.
* Ability to drive continuous improvement and challenge existing processes constructively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, BRIM, RAR, ARIBA, billing platforms, and revenue or cash applications.
* Experience with data analytics, reporting, and customer lifecycle systems (e.g., Looker, Power BI, SQL).
* Experience in telecommunications, subscription\-based, or high\-volume billing environments.
* PMP, ScrumMaster, or similar project management or Agile certification.

**Physical Demands \& Work Conditions**

* Primarily office\-based or remote work environment with prolonged use of a computer and standard office equipment.
* Ability to attend meetings (virtual and in\-person) and work across multiple time zones as needed.
* Occasional travel may be required based on project needs.

jobs.title: Convergent Mediation Engineer (Evergreen)
jobs.description:
Role Description:

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer\-facing brands \- Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com, Rentalcars.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. During 2019, the Company had consolidated revenues and net income of $15\.1 billion and $4\.9 billion, respectively, and a current market value of approximately $90 billion.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a Center of Excellence based in Bangalore, India and a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units.

 **Job Overview:**


The Financial Systems team provides technology expertise to the finance department and is responsible for SAP, HANA, and connected 3rd party systems at Booking.com. We want to change the way people work with SAP, by building a finance application platform that supports simplification of business processes and empowers the finance community with better financial insights.We power our Financial Systems using SAP technology like FICA, BRIM (Convergent Mediation, Convergent Invoicing etc), ABAP, HANA, Java, Kafka, Mulesoft and SAP S/4 HANA 2022\.

  



As a **Developer specialized in SAP Convergent Mediation** **(CM)** you will work on bringing in various business critical data from upstream systems, reconcile data based on the relevant Business process within Financial Systems and generate business relevant transactions to be consumed in FICA and SAP CI. You will collaborate with SAP Functional Engineers, SAP ABAP Developers, Kafka specialists, Product Managers and Architects across various teams within the organization to build the relevant Integration between upstream systems and SAP.

  



**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own CM solutions end\-to\-end from design through deployment, monitoring, and operational support in production.
* Design scalable solutions using SAP Convergent Mediation and Booking’s Kafka infrastructure for Finance relevant use cases.
* Building Workflows and Configurations to Collect Finance specific data from upstream systems using Kafka, File/FTP, REST, Database methods.
* Use various data formats like Avro to process and decode data to create relevant BITs for SAP CI and FICA.
* Build Unit, Integration and Automation tests for the various workflows in CM and integrate them with relevant upstream and downstream systems.
* Integrate CM workflows with specific version control systems like git and Gitlab.
* Debug and correct CM issues including issues from upstream and downstream interfaces.
* Collaborate with SAP Functional FICA specialists, ABAP developers, Architects, Product Managers and Leadership on a regular basis to comprehend, design and build business critical integration activities within SAP CM.
* Participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident improvements for CM workflows and integrations.
* Mentor junior engineers / support onboarding and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Apply architectural, security, and non\-functional best practices when designing scalable CM integrations.

 **What You’ll Be Bringing**

* 5 \- 9 years of Software Design and Development Experience in integration and related technologies.
* In Depth Hands\-on knowledge of **SAP Convergent Mediation** (CM) with abilities to design and build Workflows.
* Ability to build scalable solutions in SAP CM and supporting Logging, Tracing and Alerting with various tools.
* Ability to use version control tools like git and GitLab with CM is highly preferred.
* Building monitoring Dashboards using Loki, Grafana, Prometheus etc
* Knowledge of building Unit, Integration and Automation tests using SAP CM is highly desirable.
* Deep experience in working with Large data sources with ability to build a scalable CM solution using Kafka, REST API, File/FTP and Database sources.
* Processing and Decoding different UDRs and being able to use data formats like Avro.
* Creating Co\-relations, Processing the relevant inputs and generating BITs for SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI) and FICA.
* Hands\-on experience in **SAP HANA (mandatory), AWS ( RDS, Athena, SNS, SNQ, and SAP BRIM (good to have)**
* **Good hands on Devops , CI/CD and Change management**
* Experience or Exposure to Java and Kafka is highly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Agile processes, Test Automation Tools is good to have.
* An Engineering/Science degree in Computer Science/ Electrical/Electronics/ IT etc .Innovation and Team Player mindset.
* **Job location is Bengaluru**
